  name,

}) {

  const s = size || 24;

    xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
    width: s,
    height: s,
    viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "currentColor",
    strokeWidth: 2,
    strokeLinecap: "round",
    strokeLinejoin: "round",
    className: className || ""
  }, data.map(function (item, i) {
    return React.createElement(item[0], Object.assign({
      key: i
    }, item[1]));
  }));
}

/* ---- Intersection Observer hook ---- */
function useInView(options) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  useEffect(function () {
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
        setVisible(true);
        obs.unobserve(entries[0].target);
      }
    }, Object.assign({
      threshold: 0.15
    }, options || {}));
    if (ref.current) obs.observe(ref.current);
    return function () {
      obs.disconnect();
    };
  }, []);
  return [ref, visible];
}

/* ---- Animated Counter ---- */
function Counter({
  target,
  suffix,
  duration
}) {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [ref, visible] = useInView();
  const dur = duration || 2000;
  const suf = suffix || "";
  useEffect(function () {
    if (!visible) return;
    const num = parseInt(target.toString().replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""));
    const steps = 60;
    const inc = num / steps;
    let step = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(function () {
      step++;
      setCount(Math.min(Math.floor(inc * step), num));
      if (step >= steps) clearInterval(timer);
    }, dur / steps);
    return function () {
      clearInterval(timer);
    };
  }, [visible, target, dur]);
  return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("span", {
    ref: ref
  }, count.toLocaleString(), suf);
}

/* ---- Section wrapper with fade-in ---- */

  id,
  children,
  className,
  dark
}) {
  const [ref, visible] = useInView();
  return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("section", {
    id: id,
    ref: ref,
    className: "py-20 md:py-28 px-4 " + (dark ? "bg-dark" : "bg-surface") + " " + (className || "")
  }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", {
    className: "max-w-7xl mx-auto fade-up " + (visible ? "visible" : "")
  }, children));
}

  }, subtitle));
}

/* ---- About ---- */
function About() {
  const features = [{
    icon: "target",
    title: "Our Mission",
    desc: "Empowering individuals and enterprises with the skills, tools, and strategies needed to thrive in the blockchain ecosystem."
  }, {
    icon: "globe",
    title: "Global Reach",
    desc: "Headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA, we serve partners and students worldwide through our digital platform and consultation services."
  }, {
    icon: "link",
    title: "Partnership Approach",
    desc: "We develop, maintain, and evaluate blockchain products for partners globally, providing long-term technical and operational assistance."
  }, {
    icon: "network",
    title: "Unified Ecosystem",

  }, faqs.map(function (faq, i) {

      key: i,

    }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("button", {
      onClick: function () {
        setOpenIndex(openIndex === i ? null : i);
      },

    }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Icon, {

/* ---- Back to Top ---- */
function BackToTop() {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  useEffect(function () {
    const onScroll = function () {
      setShow(window.scrollY > 500);
    };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, {
      passive: true
    });
    return function () {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
    };
  }, []);
  if (!show) return null;
  return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: function () {
      window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: "smooth"
      });
    },
    className: "no-print fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-primary to-secondary text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-primary/30 hover:scale-110 transition-all",
    "aria-label": "Back to top"
  }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "arrowUp",
    size: 20,
    className: "text-white"
  }));
}

/* ---- Cookie Consent ---- */
function CookieConsent() {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  useEffect(function () {
    if (!localStorage.getItem("we2blocks_cookies")) {
      const timer = setTimeout(function () {
        setShow(true);
      }, 2000);
      return function () {
        clearTimeout(timer);
      };
    }
  }, []);
  const accept = function () {
    localStorage.setItem("we2blocks_cookies", "accepted");
    setShow(false);
  };
  if (!show) return null;
  return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", {
    className: "no-print fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-surface/98 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10 p-4 md:p-5"
  }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", {
    className: "max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4"
  }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-slate-400 text-sm text-center sm:text-left"
  }, "We use cookies to enhance your experience. By continuing to visit this site you agree to our use of cookies."), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: accept,
    className: "shrink-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-secondary text-white px-6 py-2.5 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold hover:shadow-lg transition-all"
  }, "Accept")));
}

/* ---- Scroll Progress ---- */
function useScrollProgress() {
  useEffect(function () {
    const bar = document.getElementById("scroll-progress");
    const update = function () {
      const scroll = window.scrollY;
      const height = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
      const progress = height > 0 ? scroll / height * 100 : 0;
      if (bar) bar.style.width = progress + "%";
    };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", update, {
      passive: true
    });
    return function () {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", update);
    };
  }, []);
}

/* ---- App ---- */
function App() {
  useScrollProgress();
  return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(React.Fragment, null, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Navbar, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Hero, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(About, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Services, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Academy, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Courses, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Industries, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(WhyUs, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Stats, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(LearningPath, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(FAQ, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(CTABanner, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Contact, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Footer, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(BackToTop, null), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(CookieConsent, null));
}

function Icon({ name, size, className }) {
  const data = ICON_DATA[name];
  if (!data) return null;
  const s = size || 24;
  return (
    <svg
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      width={s}
      height={s}
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={2}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      className={className || ""}
    >
      {data.map(function (item, i) {
        return React.createElement(item[0], Object.assign({ key: i }, item[1]));
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}

/* ---- Professional SVG Logo: stylized W2B with blockchain nodes ---- */
function Logo({ size }) {
  const w = size || 140;
  const h = (w / 140) * 40;
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 140 40" width={w} height={h} xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="inline-block">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="logoGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#7C3AED" />
          <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#06B6D4" />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <line x1="10" y1="10" x2="26" y2="10" stroke="#7C3AED" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.5" />
      <line x1="10" y1="10" x2="10" y2="30" stroke="#A855F7" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.5" />
      <line x1="10" y1="10" x2="26" y2="30" stroke="#06B6D4" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.5" />
      <line x1="26" y1="10" x2="26" y2="30" stroke="#06B6D4" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.5" />
      <line x1="10" y1="30" x2="26" y2="30" stroke="#7C3AED" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.5" />
      <line x1="26" y1="10" x2="10" y2="30" stroke="#A855F7" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.4" />
      <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="4" fill="#7C3AED" />
      <circle cx="26" cy="10" r="3.5" fill="#06B6D4" />
      <circle cx="10" cy="30" r="3" fill="#A855F7" />
      <circle cx="26" cy="30" r="3.5" fill="#7C3AED" />
      <circle cx="18" cy="20" r="2.5" fill="#06B6D4" opacity="0.7" />
      <text x="42" y="28" fontFamily="Space Grotesk, sans-serif" fontSize="22" fontWeight="bold" fill="url(#logoGrad)">W2B</text>
      <text x="82" y="28" fontFamily="Space Grotesk, sans-serif" fontSize="11" fontWeight="500" fill="#94A3B8" letterSpacing="1">locks</text>
    </svg>
  );
}

/* ---- Intersection Observer hook ---- */
function useInView(options) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  useEffect(function () {
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      if (entries[0].isIntersecting) { setVisible(true); obs.unobserve(entries[0].target); }
    }, Object.assign({ threshold: 0.15 }, options || {}));
    if (ref.current) obs.observe(ref.current);
    return function () { obs.disconnect(); };
  }, []);
  return [ref, visible];
}

/* ---- Animated Counter ---- */
function Counter({ target, suffix, duration }) {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [ref, visible] = useInView();
  const dur = duration || 2000;
  const suf = suffix || "";
  useEffect(function () {
    if (!visible) return;
    const num = parseInt(target.toString().replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""));
    const steps = 60;
    const inc = num / steps;
    let step = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(function () {
      step++;
      setCount(Math.min(Math.floor(inc * step), num));
      if (step >= steps) clearInterval(timer);
    }, dur / steps);
    return function () { clearInterval(timer); };
  }, [visible, target, dur]);
  return <span ref={ref}>{count.toLocaleString()}{suf}</span>;
}

/* ---- Section wrapper with fade-in ---- */
function Section({ id, children, className, dark }) {
  const [ref, visible] = useInView();
  return (
    <section id={id} ref={ref} className={"py-20 md:py-28 px-4 " + (dark ? "bg-dark" : "bg-surface") + " " + (className || "")}>
      <div className={"max-w-7xl mx-auto fade-up " + (visible ? "visible" : "")}>{children}</div>
    </section>
  );
}

function SectionTitle({ title, subtitle }) {
  return (
    <div className="text-center mb-16">
      <h2 className="font-heading text-3xl md:text-5xl font-bold gradient-text mb-4">{title}</h2>
      {subtitle && <p className="text-slate-400 text-lg max-w-2xl mx-auto">{subtitle}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---- Navigation ---- */
function Navbar() {
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);
  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);
  const links = [
    { label: "About", href: "#about" },
    { label: "Services", href: "#services" },
    { label: "Academy", href: "#academy" },
    { label: "Courses", href: "#courses" },
    { label: "Industries", href: "#industries" },
    { label: "FAQ", href: "#faq" },
    { label: "Contact", href: "#contact" }
  ];

  useEffect(function () {
    const onScroll = function () { setScrolled(window.scrollY > 40); };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    return function () { window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll); };
  }, []);

  const handleClick = function (e, href) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setMobileOpen(false);
    const el = document.querySelector(href);
    if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  return (
    <nav className={"fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 transition-all duration-300 no-print " + (scrolled ? "bg-dark/95 backdrop-blur-lg shadow-xl shadow-primary/5" : "bg-transparent")}>
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 flex items-center justify-between h-16 md:h-20">
        <a href="#" className="flex items-center gap-1 group" aria-label="We2Blocks Home">
          <Logo size={120} />
        </a>

        <div className="hidden lg:flex items-center gap-7">
          {links.map(function (l) {
            return (
              <a key={l.label} href={l.href} onClick={function (e) { handleClick(e, l.href); }} className="text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-colors text-sm font-medium">
                {l.label}
              </a>
            );
          })}
          <a href="#academy" onClick={function (e) { handleClick(e, "#academy"); }} className="bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-secondary text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/25 transition-all">
            Start Learning
          </a>
        </div>

        <button onClick={function () { setMobileOpen(!mobileOpen); }} className="lg:hidden p-2 text-white" aria-label="Toggle menu">
          <div className="w-6 h-5 flex flex-col justify-between">
            <span className={"hamburger-line block h-0.5 w-6 bg-white rounded " + (mobileOpen ? "rotate-45 translate-y-[9px]" : "")} />
            <span className={"hamburger-line block h-0.5 w-6 bg-white rounded " + (mobileOpen ? "opacity-0" : "")} />
            <span className={"hamburger-line block h-0.5 w-6 bg-white rounded " + (mobileOpen ? "-rotate-45 -translate-y-[9px]" : "")} />
          </div>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className={"mobile-menu lg:hidden " + (mobileOpen ? "max-h-[500px] opacity-100" : "max-h-0 opacity-0") + " overflow-hidden bg-dark/98 backdrop-blur-xl"}>
        <div className="px-6 py-4 space-y-3 border-t border-white/5">
          {links.map(function (l) {
            return (
              <a key={l.label} href={l.href} onClick={function (e) { handleClick(e, l.href); }} className="block text-slate-300 hover:text-white py-2 text-sm font-medium">
                {l.label}
              </a>
            );
          })}
          <a href="#academy" onClick={function (e) { handleClick(e, "#academy"); }} className="block bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-secondary text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold text-center mt-3">
            Start Learning
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}

                    <Icon name={step.icon} size={30} className="text-secondary" />
                  </div>

                    {step.label}
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="font-heading text-xl font-semibold text-white mb-2">{step.title}</h3>
                  <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm leading-relaxed max-w-xs mx-auto">{step.desc}</p>
                  {i < steps.length - 1 && (
                    <div className="md:hidden flex justify-center my-4">

  const faqs = [
    {

    },

      a: "Yes. Upon completing our programs, you receive a certification that validates your blockchain skills and knowledge, recognized across the industry."
    },
    {
      q: "What consultation services does We2Blocks provide?",
      a: "We provide end-to-end blockchain consultation including strategy assessment, architecture design, product development, integration planning, and long-term technical assistance for businesses adopting blockchain technology."
    },
    {
      q: "Where can I access We2Blocks courses?",
      a: "Our courses are available through the We2Blocks Academy platform as well as on leading learning platforms including Eduonix, BitDegree, and others."
    },
    {
      q: "Can We2Blocks help integrate blockchain into my existing business?",
      a: "Yes. Our business integration service specializes in connecting companies, employees, and business assets into a unified blockchain ecosystem. We provide long-term support throughout and beyond the integration process."
    }
  ];
  return (

      <SectionTitle title="Frequently Asked Questions" subtitle="Common questions about our blockchain training and consultation services." />
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto space-y-4">
        {faqs.map(function (faq, i) {
          return (
            <div key={i} className="gradient-border overflow-hidden">
              <button onClick={function () { setOpenIndex(openIndex === i ? null : i); }} className="w-full text-left p-6 flex items-center justify-between gap-4" aria-expanded={openIndex === i}>
                <span className="font-heading text-white font-semibold">{faq.q}</span>
                <span className={"shrink-0 transition-transform duration-300 " + (openIndex === i ? "rotate-180" : "")}>
                  <Icon name="chevronDown" size={20} className="text-secondary" />
                </span>
              </button>
              <div className={"faq-content " + (openIndex === i ? "open" : "")}>
                <p className="px-6 pb-6 text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">{faq.a}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </Section>
  );
}

/* ---- CTA Banner ---- */
function CTABanner() {
  const scrollTo = function (e, href) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const el = document.querySelector(href);
    if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  };
  const [ref, visible] = useInView();
  return (
    <section ref={ref} className="py-20 md:py-28 px-4 relative overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-primary/20 via-dark to-secondary/20">
      <div className="absolute inset-0">
        <div className="absolute top-0 left-1/4 w-96 h-96 bg-primary/10 rounded-full blur-3xl" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-0 right-1/4 w-96 h-96 bg-secondary/10 rounded-full blur-3xl" />
      </div>
      <div className={"relative z-10 max-w-4xl mx-auto text-center fade-up " + (visible ? "visible" : "")}>
        <h2 className="font-heading text-3xl md:text-5xl font-bold text-white mb-6">
          Begin Your <span className="gradient-text">Blockchain Journey</span>
        </h2>
        <p className="text-slate-300 text-lg max-w-2xl mx-auto mb-10 leading-relaxed">
          Whether you are looking to learn blockchain fundamentals, develop enterprise solutions, or transform your business operations — we are here to guide you every step of the way.
        </p>
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-4">
          <a href="#courses" onClick={function (e) { scrollTo(e, "#courses"); }} className="w-full sm:w-auto bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-secondary text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-full text-base font-semibold hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-primary/30 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <Icon name="bookOpen" size={20} className="text-white" /> Explore Courses
          </a>
          <a href="#contact" onClick={function (e) { scrollTo(e, "#contact"); }} className="w-full sm:w-auto border border-white/20 text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-full text-base font-semibold hover:bg-white/5 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <Icon name="send" size={20} className="text-white" /> Contact Us
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/* ---- Contact ---- */
function Contact() {
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const handleSubmit = function (e) { e.preventDefault(); setSubmitted(true); };
  const emailUser = "info";
  const emailDomain = "we2blocks.com";
  return (
    <Section id="contact" dark>
      <SectionTitle title="Get in Touch" subtitle="Ready to transform your career or business with blockchain? Reach out today." />
      <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-5 gap-12">
        <div className="lg:col-span-3">
          {submitted ? (
            <div className="gradient-border p-12 text-center">
              <div className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-primary to-secondary flex items-center justify-center mb-6">
                <Icon name="check" size={32} className="text-white" />
              </div>
              <h3 className="font-heading text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-3">Message Sent!</h3>
              <p className="text-slate-400">Thank you for reaching out. Our team will get back to you within 24 hours.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="gradient-border p-8 space-y-5">
              <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm text-slate-300 font-medium mb-2">Full Name</label>
                  <input type="text" required placeholder="Your name" className="w-full bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:border-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm text-slate-300 font-medium mb-2">Email</label>

/* ---- Back to Top ---- */
function BackToTop() {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  useEffect(function () {
    const onScroll = function () { setShow(window.scrollY > 500); };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    return function () { window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll); };
  }, []);
  if (!show) return null;
  return (
    <button
      onClick={function () { window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" }); }}
      className="no-print fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-primary to-secondary text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-primary/30 hover:scale-110 transition-all"
      aria-label="Back to top"
    >
      <Icon name="arrowUp" size={20} className="text-white" />
    </button>
  );
}

/* ---- Cookie Consent ---- */
function CookieConsent() {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  useEffect(function () {
    if (!localStorage.getItem("we2blocks_cookies")) {
      const timer = setTimeout(function () { setShow(true); }, 2000);
      return function () { clearTimeout(timer); };
    }
  }, []);
  const accept = function () {
    localStorage.setItem("we2blocks_cookies", "accepted");
    setShow(false);
  };
  if (!show) return null;
  return (
    <div className="no-print fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-surface/98 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10 p-4 md:p-5">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm text-center sm:text-left">
          We use cookies to enhance your experience. By continuing to visit this site you agree to our use of cookies.
        </p>
        <button onClick={accept} className="shrink-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-secondary text-white px-6 py-2.5 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold hover:shadow-lg transition-all">
          Accept
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---- Scroll Progress ---- */
function useScrollProgress() {
  useEffect(function () {
    const bar = document.getElementById("scroll-progress");
    const update = function () {
      const scroll = window.scrollY;
      const height = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
      const progress = height > 0 ? (scroll / height) * 100 : 0;
      if (bar) bar.style.width = progress + "%";
    };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", update, { passive: true });
    return function () { window.removeEventListener("scroll", update); };
  }, []);
}

/* ---- App ---- */
function App() {
  useScrollProgress();
  return (
    <>
      <Navbar />
      <Hero />
      <About />
      <Services />
      <Academy />
      <Courses />
      <Industries />
      <WhyUs />
      <Stats />
      <LearningPath />
      <FAQ />
      <CTABanner />
      <Contact />
      <Footer />
      <BackToTop />
      <CookieConsent />
    </>
  );
}

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById("root")).render(<App />);
</script>
